selected_backend.api: Clang libclang translation-unit parser through libclang-ng

candidates.syntax_fidelity: complete compiler grammar for the configured Clang version; Clang translation-unit AST
candidates.templates: template declarations and parameters exposed where representable by CIndex
candidates.overload_resolution: Clang semantic references where the translation unit configuration resolves them
candidates.includes_macros: compile database flags, include directives, macro processing and compiler diagnostics
candidates.packaging: bundled libclang shared library inside a Python one-dir helper; no external LLVM install
candidates.semantic_scope: common IR structural subset; advanced Sema details remain an explicit follow-up

candidates.syntax_fidelity: compiler-authoritative C/C++ parser and full C++ AST/Sema integration
candidates.includes_macros: preprocessor and include graph available from Clang frontend/tooling
candidates.packaging: larger native helper plus required Clang/LLVM toolchain assets

candidates.syntax_fidelity: insufficient for Common IR semantic analysis

helper_distribution.delivery: PyInstaller one-dir with bundled CPython and libclang
helper_distribution.external_sdk_policy: do not require LLVM installation; project/system SDK headers may improve semantic completeness when available

project_strategy.fallback: C++20 defaults plus the source directory as a quoted-include path
project_strategy.missing_headers: emit diagnostics and unresolved facts; do not invent symbols
project_strategy.system_headers: do not silently claim complete semantics when required platform/toolchain headers are unavailable

known_limits: Exact C++ semantics depend strongly on compile flags, macros and include paths.
Bundling libclang does not automatically provide every platform/vendor standard library or SDK header.
Translation units with missing headers may still yield partial AST/diagnostics but symbol resolution can be incomplete.
CIndex exposes less semantic detail than LibTooling; move advanced template-instantiation and Sema needs to LibTooling in a follow-up.
tree-sitter-cpp may be used later for malformed editor-buffer syntax fallback.
